role: In-memory, MainActor @Observable singleton holding the last 10 outbound LLM requests (system prompt, messages JSON, tools JSON, streamed response, usage, error) for the Troubleshooting prompt-audit page.
types: LLMRequestAudit: final class (@Observable @MainActor) — FIFO audit log
state: mem:LLMRequestAudit.responseTrimSlack = 10_000 (how far a streamed reply may run past the cap before it is cut back)
toplevel: Singleton `shared`; constants maxEntries 10, maxPayloadCharacters 60000 and responseTrimSlack 10000. Entry.responseCharacterCount (default 0) tracks responseText's length as deltas arrive. Never persisted; cleared by the audit page's Clear button and DataPurgeService.purgeHealthCaches.

units.does: Appends one streamed delta to responseText and adds its length to responseCharacterCount; once the count passes maxPayloadCharacters + responseTrimSlack (70,000), keeps only the last maxPayloadCharacters (60,000) and resets the count to that. Costs the delta, not the reply, except at a cut.
units.entry: Called in place on the entries array by LLMRequestAudit.append(textDelta:to:).

branches.effect: cut back to the last 60,000 characters; else return

units.does: Creates an Entry (new UUID, now, payloads capped to 60k chars, no usage, empty response), inserts it at index 0, trims entries to 10, returns the id.

branches.effect: drops the oldest tail entries; otherwise nothing

units.does: Appends a streamed text delta to the entry with that id, mutating it in place in the entries array (Entry.appendResponse: length kept as deltas arrive, cut to the last 60k characters once it runs 10k past them); no-op if the entry was already evicted.

branches.effect: false: returns silently (entry evicted or cleared); true: appendResponse

units.does: Stores the usage block on the entry with that id; silently no-op if not found.
Stores an error description on the entry with that id; silently no-op if not found.
Returns the string unchanged if ≤ 60k chars, else its first 60k chars plus '[…truncated N chars]'.

branches.effect: false: returns s; true: truncates and appends marker
